The '''Administrative Sector''' also known as the '''Administrative Precinct''' or '''Admin Sector''', was an area of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] near the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. It contained the [[Coruscant Central Court (building)|Coruscant Central Court building]], [[Coruscant Court of Appeals (building)|Coruscant Court of Appeals building]], and the [[Senate Overflow Offices]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] it was the location of a [[Coruscant Administrative Sector terrorist attack|terrorist attack]].
